correctness.rationale: In the reviewed mathematical statement, for any period-dividing-two orbit set a=s0r0 and b=s1r1. Stock conservation gives a+b=2c and s1-s0=(b-a)/2. Response equations give the same difference b/h(a)-a/h(b). If b>a, nondecreasing h and 0<h<1 force b/h(a)-a/h(b)>b-a>(b-a)/2; swap indices for a>b. Then a=b=c and the points coincide. This covers discontinuous and constant nondecreasing h without differential hypotheses. Independent rational arithmetic checks the 4/5,3/8 ↔1,7/10 two-cycle under a smooth strictly decreasing logistic; its endpoint log-odds are exact. This says nothing about period >=3.
